subject: Logic 13 track toggles after a track-name click: the focus is an unchanged text field under the name field, and writing AXFocused on the Tracks group leaves it
question: After a track name is focused, why do mute, solo and arm refuse, can an AX press toggle instead, and can focus be moved off the field without losing text?

reverify.command: On a fresh copy of a four-track project, write AXFocused on the name text field of track 1 through Accessibility and read the focused element and its parents. Call logic_tracks mute, solo and arm on index 1 and read each header checkbox with a separate Accessibility reader. Repeat with Track > Rename Track open and text written into the field.
reverify.expected: With the name field focused each op returns State A and the reader shows the change; with a rename editor holding pending text each op returns State C unsafe_focus_for_synthetic_key and the field keeps its text.
reverify.cost: A disposable project copy per trial; no save.

method: Measured main at 9664b4f1 (release build) for 3 trials on a fresh fixture copy each, with focus (a) as at project open, (b) after AXPress on the header name field, (c) after AXFocused written on the name text field; mute, solo and arm on track 1 each. Probed, in the name-field state, AXFocused written on the header group and on the Tracks group, and AXPress on the mute checkbox. Opened Track > Rename Track with pending text for comparison. Ran the fix build for 3 trials in state (c) and 1 trial with the rename editor holding pending text and 3 operations. Every trial read the header checkboxes with a separate reader.

observations.what: AXPress on the header name field
AXFocused written on the name text field
observations.focus_after: AXTextField child of the name AXTextField; value equals the track name; whole name selected; value and selection range settable

observations.what: AXPress on the mute checkbox with that field focused
AXFocused written on the header group with that field focused
AXFocused written on the Tracks group (first AXGroup above the header group) with that field focused
rename editor from Track > Rename Track with pending text
fix build, AXFocused written on the name text field
fix build, rename editor with pending text

conclusion: The refusal after a name click is the focus guard seeing a text field. When that field's value equals the committed name nothing is pending: focus moves to the Tracks group and the key then lands, State A in 9 of 9 operations. AXPress on the mute checkbox does not flip it while the field is focused, so the press route is not available. A rename editor with pending text keeps its text and the refusal. Focus on the track contents at project open is an ordinary start state and does not refuse the toggles.
limits: No real mouse click was made; the state was produced with AXFocused.
A name field with pending text in the name-field shape was covered by unit tests only.
Other locales and other Logic builds are not measured.
